games.title: Bean Snake
games.description: Classic grid snake with turbo speed modes, wrap-around toggle, and local high-score saves.
games.controls: Arrow Keys or WASD · Space to Pause

games.title: Neon Tetris
games.description: Full 7-bag Tetromino stacker with ghost piece, Hold slot, Next preview, and auto-save state.
games.controls: ←/→ Move · ↑ Rotate · ↓ Soft Drop · Space Hard Drop · C Hold

games.title: 2048 Vault
games.description: Slide and merge numbered tiles to reach 2048 with instant Undo and persistent board state.
games.controls: Arrow Keys or WASD · Z to Undo

games.title: Cyber Minesweeper
games.description: First-click safe minefield with Easy, Medium, and Hard grids, flag mode, and best times.
games.controls: Left Click Reveal · Right Click (or Flag Mode) to Flag

games.title: Flappy Bean
games.description: One-button arcade flyer featuring Mr. Bean's emerald glider, medals, and 60fps physics.
